submissions.note:
- Added `src/point_add/trailmix_port/`, a local port of the TrailMix
  `emit_test_ec_add_shrunken_pz` style circuit adapted to the challenge builder
  and op model.
- Switched `point_add::build()` to emit this TrailMix route by default. The old
  dialog route remains available via `POINT_ADD_DIALOG_ROUTE=1`.

- Cut the generated operation count from the first validated 999q port by using
  a 128-bit top-window CLZ/bitlength bound and generated universal shift bounds
  instead of retaining the full-width safety windows.

- Replaced the highest-pressure TrailMix classical-register add paths with
  zero-temp direct creg add/sub paths to keep the peak below 1000 qubits.
